page.layout: The scan shows a parchment or vellum leaf lying on a grey support, with a colour scale (black and white squares) at lower right and a blue background at upper left. No printed text is visible on the leaf: only stains, show-through, fastening tabs and damage on the parchment, and the grey mount and colour chart.
page.notes: No printed text, running head, page number, catchword or signature can be read on this scan. The visible marks are dark stains, abrasions and diffuse show-through on the leaf, plus metal fastening tabs along the left edge. The blue background, grey mount and colour scale are digitiser or photographic material and are left out.
